profile.title: Software Engineer
profile.headline: I build backend services, automation platforms, and real-time monitoring systems that keep production software — and the networks behind it — reliable.
summary: Software Engineer with 3.5+ years of experience building backend services, automation platforms, cloud-native applications, and distributed systems.
I engineer scalable REST APIs, CI/CD pipelines, real-time monitoring solutions, and AI-powered knowledge systems using Python, Java, FastAPI, React.js, Jenkins, and cloud technologies.
I pair strong software fundamentals with hands-on depth in microservices, system reliability, performance engineering, and network protocols to ship robust, production-ready solutions.

focus.title: Backend & APIs

focus.text: Jira-triggered CI pipelines, Robot Framework suites, soak, regression, and performance testing.

focus.title: Networking & AI Tooling
focus.text: Broadband gateway validation across GPON / XGS-PON, plus RAG-based knowledge assistants.

highlights.label: Lab devices monitored in real time
Validation tasks run by automated pipelines
Voice messages processed monthly via APIs

bullets: Engineered an end-to-end automated validation pipeline (Python, FastAPI, Jenkins, Robot Framework, Linux) that triggers sanity and regression suites directly from Jira tasks — cutting validation to a 30-minute window, auto-publishing results and diagnostic logs, and processing ~250 validation tasks per month.

Designed and built a centralized real-time device monitoring platform (Python, FastAPI, WebSockets, PostgreSQL) tracking the health of ~100 lab devices concurrently, detecting CPU spikes and crash-reboots, and capturing diagnostic logs for faster root-cause analysis.

Developed Python automation and soak-testing workflows for BGW720 and BGW620 broadband gateways using Robot Framework and Spirent traffic generators, enabling repeatable firmware stability, connectivity, and IPv4 traffic validation under sustained load.

Validated IEEE 802.1X Supplicant, ECO Connectivity, TR-181 & TR-369, and SFP compatibility across GPON, XGS-PON, AE, and External ONT configurations, executing OLT-side provisioning through Nokia AMS.
Drove next-generation gateway release validation through firmware sanity, regression, interoperability, and stability testing, supporting the platform's progression toward General Availability.
Built an AI-powered engineering knowledge assistant over internal repository docs and Review Board commands, giving engineers self-service access to implementation guidance and development workflows.
Integrated frontend validation hooks into 2 payroll dashboards with React and TypeScript, connected to an internal anomaly-detection API — cutting manual HR data-entry steps from 8 to 5.
Developed 4 Python REST API endpoints to replace legacy point-to-point transfers, reducing inter-service round-trip latency from 600ms to under 180ms.
Rewrote local Docker configurations to standardize the team environment, reducing new-engineer onboarding setup from 2 days to half a day.
Developed Python and SQL utilities to process hardware telemetry data and support investigation of recurring device issues.
Contributed to Java Spring Boot backend services, delivering feature enhancements, API integrations, and maintenance.
Monitored and troubleshot Apache Kafka pipelines, investigating message-processing failures and data-flow issues across backend systems.
Developed Python regression suites with Quart to simulate SIP phone interactions and validate voicemail services, reducing regression defects by 35%.
Supported migration of voicemail services from AWS to a multi-cloud microservices architecture, deploying test workloads as Kubernetes pods and reducing deployment time by 20%.
Developed and tested agent-setup APIs for call handling and voicemail retrieval, integrating Azure Blob Storage to process 100K+ voice messages per month.
Automated deployment workflows migrating Genesys Predictive Routing (GPR) to microservices, enabling its first Azure deployment and reducing deployment errors by 25%.
Designed and validated predictive-scoring routing strategies in Genesys Routing Composer, improving call-routing efficiency by 15%.
Ran Locust performance tests on GPR APIs to find peak-load bottlenecks, reducing latency by 15% and improving throughput by 10%.
Monitored Jenkins CI pipelines and regression results to catch release-blocking defects for services targeting 99.9% uptime.

projects.title: True Interview
projects.tagline: AI-tool detection platform for virtual coding interviews
bullets: Built a virtual coding-interview platform with React, Node.js, and WebSockets for live candidate sessions.
Integrated Python's psutil to monitor system processes and flag potential AI-tool usage during interviews.
Containerized the full application with Docker for consistent deployment.

projects.title: Distributed-System Time Synchronization
projects.tagline: Research on clock sync for a multi-node gunshot-detection system
bullets: Developed and evaluated a Python time-synchronization simulation tool for a multi-node gunshot-detection system.
Improved simulated clock synchronization from millisecond to microsecond precision.
Validated simulation results through field tests.
